sourceMeta.notice: 此快照仅包含公开的结构化观察数据，不包含 FromSoftware 游戏档案。

circleMeta.purpose: Where each night circle closes, and which boss waits there, per seed.
circleMeta.source: Names and bosses come from the Night 1 and Night 2 columns of the spreadsheet.
circleMeta.positions: Found on the rendered maps: for each name the mean blue tint of the seeds carrying it is contrasted against the seeds that do not, which leaves only that circle, and the peak of the contrast is its centre. Every centre within 12 units of a point marked by hand in nightbosses_coord/ is snapped to that point. A name shared by several map types is averaged across them; they agree to within a few units.
circleMeta.shiftingEarth: On a Shifting Earth map night 2 always closes inside the Shifting Earth, so those names belong to that map type alone.
circleMeta.label: Rendered as 1. <boss> and 2. <boss>, matching the old maps.
circleMeta.generated: Positions by scripts/locate_night_circles.py, this file by scripts/build_night_circles.py. Regenerate rather than hand-editing.

greatHollowCircleMeta.purpose: Where the Day 2 Circle marker sits on the Great Hollow, per seed.
greatHollowCircleMeta.source: The two spots come from Day_2_Circle.png. Which one a seed uses was read from the rendered maps by finding the red diamond; the sheet does not carry it, since its Night 2 Circle column is Divine Tower on every seed.
greatHollowCircleMeta.label: Rendered as text only, in the same style as the Limveld map events.
